source = '''from collections import Counter


def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    row_cuts = [-1] + sep_rows + [h]
    col_cuts = [-1] + sep_cols + [w]
    row_ranges = [(row_cuts[i] + 1, row_cuts[i + 1]) for i in range(len(row_cuts) - 1) if row_cuts[i + 1] > row_cuts[i] + 1]
    col_ranges = [(col_cuts[i] + 1, col_cuts[i + 1]) for i in range(len(col_cuts) - 1) if col_cuts[i + 1] > col_cuts[i] + 1]
    divider_colors = {grid[r][0] for r in sep_rows} | {grid[0][c] for c in sep_cols}
    output = []
    for r0, r1 in row_ranges:
        out_row = []
        for c0, c1 in col_ranges:
            cells = [grid[r][c] for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1)]

            background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
            markers = [color for color in counts if color != background and color not in divider_colors]
            marker = markers[0] if markers else None
            out_row.append(1 if marker is not None and counts[marker] == 2 else background)

    return output
'''

source = '''from collections import Counter


def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    row_cuts = [-1] + sep_rows + [h]
    col_cuts = [-1] + sep_cols + [w]
    row_ranges = [(row_cuts[i] + 1, row_cuts[i + 1]) for i in range(len(row_cuts) - 1) if row_cuts[i + 1] > row_cuts[i] + 1]
    col_ranges = [(col_cuts[i] + 1, col_cuts[i + 1]) for i in range(len(col_cuts) - 1) if col_cuts[i + 1] > col_cuts[i] + 1]
    divider_colors = {grid[r][0] for r in sep_rows} | {grid[0][c] for c in sep_cols}
    non_dividers = [grid[r][c] for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in divider_colors]
    background = Counter(non_dividers).most_common(1)[0][0]
    output = []
    for r0, r1 in row_ranges:
        out_row = []
        for c0, c1 in col_ranges:
            positions = [(r, c) for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1) if grid[r][c] != background and grid[r][c] not in divider_colors]
            top_left_pair = (len(positions) == 2 and {(r-r0, c-c0) for r,c in positions} == {(0, 0), (1, 0)})
            out_row.append(background if top_left_pair or len(positions) < 2 else 1)
        output.append(out_row)
    return output
'''
